write_task_handoff regenerates on dispatch and injects active distilled rules with MEM ids in deterministic order, with an always-present Distilled Rules section (H-12)
goal complete emits the scorecard schema computed from ledger only, with suggestions that never change memory status
All 12 operator acceptance checks from proposal 0001 v2 pass in tests

decisions: Target is the mizutani-140/shiki platform (name collision with shikijs/shiki resolved explicitly)
.shiki/memories/ as mirror-class current-state documents; audit trail via memory_transition ledger events
Three-stage promotion separation: raw auto-capture, verified machine-validated, distilled operator-approved

Scorecard and distillation suggestions at goal completion, ledger-only sources

non_goals: No CCA core prompt or independence changes

outcome: The platform learns across Goals: failures are captured automatically as raw memories with redaction, promotion to verified requires machine-checked local evidence, distilled rules require operator approval and are revocable, handoffs deterministically inject active rules with MEM ids, and goal completion emits a ledger-derived scorecard with distillation suggestions
